airflow.title: Airflow + Python
airflow.description: An hourly DAG sketch reads a local partner file, applies the shared adapter and publishes to Delta.
airflow.scope: Illustrative DAG; requires an Airflow environment.
airflow.code:
"""Illustrative local-file DAG; needs Airflow and the Delta dependencies to run."""

import json
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

from airflow.decorators import dag, task

from architecture_patterns import partner_record_to_event
from delta_events import publish_events


@dag(schedule="@hourly", start_date=datetime(2026, 1, 1), catchup=False)
def nexus_partner_ingest():
    @task
    def load_partner_batch() -> dict:
        source = Path("/opt/airflow/data/partner-events.jsonl")
        rows = [json.loads(line) for line in source.read_text().splitlines() if line]
        events = [partner_record_to_event(row) for row in rows]
        return publish_events("/opt/airflow/data/nexus-delta", events)

    load_partner_batch()


nexus_partner_ingest()

databricks.title: Databricks SQL
databricks.description: A Databricks SQL view sketch exposes a curated daily product from a validated Delta Silver table.
databricks.scope: Illustrative SQL; no Databricks workspace is connected.
databricks.code:
-- Illustrative Databricks SQL model over a validated Delta Silver table.
-- Interval energy needs measured interval width; this model shows a daily
-- event-count and average-power product without claiming measured energy.
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW gold_daily_flexibility AS
SELECT
    asset_id,
    DATE(to_timestamp(event_time)) AS event_day,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count,
    AVG(power_kw) AS average_power_kw,
    MAX(to_timestamp(event_time)) AS latest_event_at
FROM silver_events
GROUP BY asset_id, DATE(to_timestamp(event_time));

spark.title: Apache Spark
spark.description: A Spark Silver transform rejects invalid rows and keeps the latest ingested version of each event ID.
spark.scope: Illustrative transform; requires a Spark runtime.
spark.code:
def build_silver_events(bronze: DataFrame) -> DataFrame:
    typed = bronze.select(
        "event_id", "asset_id", "ingested_at",
        F.to_timestamp("event_time").alias("event_time"),
        F.col("power_kw").cast("double").alias("power_kw"),
    )
    invalid = typed.filter(
        F.col("event_id").isNull() | F.col("asset_id").isNull()
        | (F.trim(F.col("event_id")) == "") | (F.trim(F.col("asset_id")) == "")
        | F.col("event_time").isNull() | F.isnan("power_kw")
        | F.col("power_kw").isNull() | (F.abs(F.col("power_kw")) == float("inf"))
        | F.col("ingested_at").isNull()
    )
    if invalid.limit(1).count():
        raise ValueError("Bronze contains records that fail the Silver contract")
    newest = Window.partitionBy("event_id").orderBy(F.col("ingested_at").desc())
    return (typed.withColumn("_rank", F.row_number().over(newest))
            .filter(F.col("_rank") == 1).drop("_rank"))

delta.title: Delta Lake
delta.description: The runnable local reference uses Delta MERGE so repeated event IDs do not create duplicate visible rows.
delta.scope: Runnable local Delta Lake reference; synthetic events.
delta.code:
def publish_events(table_path: str | Path, events: list[dict]) -> dict:
    """Validate, then MERGE unseen event IDs into a local Delta table."""
    source = validate_events(events)  # A bad batch cannot create or change the table.
    table_path = Path(table_path)
    if not (table_path / "_delta_log").exists():
        write_deltalake(str(table_path), pa.Table.from_pylist([], schema=EVENT_SCHEMA))

    table = DeltaTable(str(table_path))
    return (
        table.merge(
            source=source,
            predicate="target.event_id = source.event_id",
            source_alias="source",
            target_alias="target",
        )
        .when_not_matched_insert_all()
        .execute()
    )

analytics.title: Analytics & BI
analytics.description: A consumer query reads the curated Gold view so the model owns the shared definition.
analytics.scope: Illustrative SQL; no BI system is connected.
analytics.code:
-- Illustrative certified consumer query; the Gold view owns the definition.
SELECT
    event_day,
    SUM(event_count) AS event_count,
    AVG(average_power_kw) AS average_asset_power_kw,
    MAX(latest_event_at) AS latest_event_at
FROM gold_daily_flexibility
GROUP BY event_day
ORDER BY event_day DESC;

trust.title: Trust across the flow
trust.description: The test proves a failed batch leaves the Delta transaction version and visible row count unchanged.
trust.scope: Runnable local test for validation before publish.
trust.code:
def test_bad_batch_does_not_publish(self) -> None:
        with TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            publish_events(directory, [event("evt-1")])
            before = DeltaTable(directory).version()

            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                publish_events(directory, [event("evt-2"), event("evt-3", float("nan"))])

            table = DeltaTable(directory)
            self.assertEqual(table.version(), before)
            self.assertEqual(table.to_pyarrow_table().num_rows, 1)
